title: Cinnamon Roll Apple Crisp
description: Cinnamon roll dough is the crust in this sweet apple crisp that is topped with icing for a decadent dessert for Thanksgiving or Christmas.
ingredients: 1 (12.4 ounce) package refrigerated cinnamon roll dough with icing
8 Granny Smith apples, peeled and sliced, or more to taste

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Roll cinnamon rolls onto a work surface to desired thickness; press into the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Mix oats, brown sugar, flour, 1 tablespoon cinnamon, and salt on a bowl; add margarine and mix until crumbly.
Spread apples over cinnamon roll crust. Mix white sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon together in a bowl and sprinkle over apples; top with oat mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven until apples are tender, 40 to 50 minutes.
Place icing in a microwave-safe bowl; heat in microwave until warmed, 20 to 30 seconds. Pour icing over crisp.

video.description: If you love apples and cinnamon, this crazy dessert will blow your mind. First press cinnamon roll dough into a baking dish, load it up with Granny Smith apples, sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar, then top with an oat-brown sugar-cinnamon crumble. Bake until the apples are bubbly and tempting, then drizzle on the icing. Whether you’re sharing for a holiday dessert or a special brunch or just because you can’t get enough cinnamon, this tempting fall dessert will quickly become one of your favorites.
